recipe.name: Bekah's Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.description: Finalized production version provided by Bekah: 6 jumbo cookies, 98 g dough per cookie, baked 350°F for 18 minutes. Ingredient-weight discrepancy flagged for review.
recipe.source: User-provided finalized Bekah's Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies production recipe, Bekah Baking ChatGPT Project, 2026-11-22. Origin: adapted from Butternut Bakery chocolate chip cookies.

ingredients.name: Flaky sea salt
ingredients.preparation: Optional topping; small pinch per cookie immediately after baking

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Plan for 4 cookies per sheet to allow adequate spreading.
Melt 1/2 cup (112 g) unsalted butter. Allow it to cool slightly so it is warm but not hot.

In a large mixing bowl, combine 1/2 cup (112 g) melted butter, 1/2 cup (100 g) packed light brown sugar, and 1/3 cup (75 g) granulated cane sugar. Whisk vigorously for 1 minute until smooth and well combined.
Add 1 large egg and 2 tsp pure vanilla extract. Whisk until fully incorporated and smooth.
Mix in 1/2 tsp baking soda, 1/2 tsp baking powder, and 1/2 tsp finely ground sea salt. Stir until evenly incorporated.
Fold in 1 1/4 cups (165 g) all-purpose flour. Mix gently until no dry flour remains. Do not overmix.
Fold in 1 1/2 cups (240 g) semisweet chocolate chips. Mix until evenly distributed throughout the dough.
Using a 6-tablespoon cookie scoop, portion the dough into 6 cookies weighing approximately 98 g each. Keep the portions rounded and place them approximately 3 inches apart.
Bake at 350°F for 18 minutes. This is your tested baking time. The cookies should have golden brown edges and slightly soft centers.

Immediately after removing the cookies from the oven, sprinkle with a small pinch of flaky sea salt, if desired. For more consistent presentation, gently round the edges with a large circular cookie cutter while the cookies are still warm.
Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and cool completely before packaging.

recipe.storage: Allow cookies to cool completely before packaging.
